title: Still Ours? — Cross-Linguistic LLM Code-Painting Instrument and Worldview Archive
description: Open-source projective code-painting instrument (p5.js 1.11.13; MIT License) and cross-linguistic worldview dataset (CC BY 4.0) probing 28 frontier and retiring language models (2024–2026; OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Mistral) across English, Chinese, and French without image-diffusion models. Includes 1,365 released Death and Love runs (540 contemporary flagship runs: 270 Death in Bitcoin block #974,473 and 270 Love in Bitcoin block #975,705; plus 825 longitudinal historical runs across 19 flagship spine and public-impact anchor models anchored in Bitcoin blocks #976,612, #976,629, and #976,634, alongside cryptographic pre-registration manifests covering 2,265 total runs). Full-resolution 1600x2000 PNGs and raw response bundles are archived separately as a companion Zenodo deposit.
